lines.text: The LORD will not keep silent for Zion until her righteousness shines like a bright light, and kings will see her glory.
Zion will be a crown of glory in the hand of the LORD and will be called Hephzibah.
Her God will rejoice over her as a bridegroom over his bride, and watchmen are posted on her walls.
The LORD swears that foreigners will never again eat her grain, and harvesters will drink the wine in His holy courts.
The people are told to raise a banner for the kings, and Zion will be called Made Whole.
